About video:
Cryptography needs randomness. Computers are deterministic.
This video explains how that paradox actually gets solved. 

00:00 The paradox of randomness on a deterministic machine                                                                 
00:53 When randomness fails: Debian 2008 & PlayStation 3 disasters                                                         
01:39 Pseudo-random number generators and the seed problem                                                                 
02:27 What entropy actually means                                                                                          
03:21 Your mouse as a cryptographic instrument                                                                             
04:11 Other entropy sources and the mixing function                                                                        
05:17 /dev/random vs /dev/urandom explained                                                                                
06:31 The freshly booted VM problem & the 2012 IPv4 scan                                                                   
07:48 Modern defenses: jitter entropy, hardware RNG, virtio-rng
08:24 The big picture — chaos from reality into your keys
